Description:
Here ist my third Progressive Psytrance Mix of 2014. 

Few days ago I had the idea to create this mix and like so often it's a REALLY special one and also a REALLY long one! :) 
It's overall 3 HOURS and 40 MINUTES and contains 30 tracks, produced between 1993-2008, which means they cover 15 years of Psychedelic Trance music!

The concept behind this mix is simple: 

THE MOST HYPNOTIC MELODIES OF THE UNIVERSE, CAREFULLY SELECTED AND PUT TOGETHER IN A SINGLE MIX!

So it comes that this mix contains MOST OF MY ABSOLUTE ETERNAL HALL OF FAME FAVORITE TRACKS!!! 
More than the half tracklist belongs them!

so, if you know me and my mixes you can already imagine what you can expect here, but also imagine this:
Some time ago I did a rough estimate and I've heard probably around 35.000-40.000 tracks in my life and this mix contains the imo very best tracks from these many thousand tracks!

If I need to describe this mix in a single word: EPIC! :)

Enjoy the next flight with "TB Spaceways" :)

Captain Hook - Deep Into Nature is the seventh track from the new "Captain Hook - Origin" album released on Iboga Records in Nov. 29th, 2018. 
Deep into nature is a tribal hypnotic trance journey. It actually got me going for the classic Goa sound in some of the main leads, followed by a deep soft beat. At some point I’ve lost track of time and let go of inhibitions completely, I’ve recorded lairs and pads which combined into one entity of a 14 minutes track. I feel this track is my personal favorite at this point of time. Enjoy the trip!

Captain Hook is the main musical project of Reshef Harari, a pioneering producer and DJ in the global Psychedelic Trance scene for over two decades. Renowned for pushing musical boundaries, his sound is a distinct fusion of vintage synthesis and modern production, blending the spiritual roots of Psytrance and Goa Trance with a cutting-edge approach. With six acclaimed albums on the legendary Iboga Records and a history of headlining the world's biggest electronic music festivals, including Boom Festival, Ozora Festival, Burning Man, Universo Paralello, Rainbow Serpent, Fusion Festival, and Antaris Festival, Captain Hook continues to be a leading force in the genre. His recent work includes the seminal album Origin, the collaborative project Alien Art with Ace Ventura, and the ambitious three-part Ouroboros remix series.
